locations.title: Tooty the Feeble
locations.description: **Solution:** ||Avoid his attack and then jump stomp the ground near him while he's dazed. Repeat this three times to defeat him.||

locations.title: Flibby
locations.description: **Solution:** ||Avoid his attacks until he's out of breath and then jump and tail swipe him in the head to knock him over. While he's lying on his back, jump and stomp on him. Repeat three times to beat him.||
